about_page.title: About Michael Moran - Cyber Security Professional
about_page.content:
Michael Moran is a distinguished cyber security professional specializing in the rapidly evolving field of artificial intelligence security. With extensive expertise in AI/ML security, threat modeling, secure architecture, and incident response, Michael has established himself as a leading authority in protecting next-generation technology systems.

His current focus centers on LLM threat modeling and prompt injection defense, working directly with organizations to identify vulnerabilities in AI systems before they can be exploited. Michael's involvement with MITRE ATLAS demonstrates his commitment to advancing the field through practical threat research and defensive strategy development.

As a SANS SEC411 instructor, Michael has developed comprehensive materials that bridge traditional cyber security knowledge with emerging AI risks. His work on the SEC411 course materials has helped thousands of security professionals understand the unique challenges posed by machine learning systems.

Michael holds multiple industry certifications including GSEC, GCIH, GPEN, AWS Security Specialty, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001. These credentials, combined with his hands-on consulting experience, enable him to deliver practical security solutions that meet both regulatory requirements and business objectives.

Based in Dublin, Ireland, Michael provides consulting services worldwide, working with organizations across finance, healthcare, technology, and government sectors. His remote-first approach ensures clients receive world-class security expertise regardless of geographic location.

Through his consulting practice and speaking engagements, Michael continues to advance the field of AI security, helping organizations navigate the complex landscape of artificial intelligence risk management while maintaining operational excellence.
